item: A persisted rollup refresh that declined before opening the store is no build: it does not open an in-memory connection as the persisted store, is not reported as built and does not end a failure run
refs: R267; audit 0.5.0 follow-up; 0.5.1 item 28 read note; PR #1515
summary: The independent reads of #1510 and of this change found two things in _refresh_persisted_build. (1) columnar.connect returns None only when DuckDB is missing or OO_COLUMNAR=0; a missing passphrase or secure backend does NOT return None, it falls through to an IN-MEMORY connection, which the function then recorded as the persisted store (_STATE[persisted]=True) and the dispatcher reported as built. So the function now reads the passphrase ONCE and returns False, before any connect, when the passphrase or secure_crypto_available() is gone since the dispatcher chose this path (the next kick takes the in-memory path, because _persisted_serve_active reads the same two things); it also returns False when the engine gives no connection (OO_COLUMNAR=0). (2) The dispatcher treated any return without raising as built: it released any hold, reset the failure run and recorded built. It now treats an explicit False as a decline: no build ran, the outcome is declined, last_skip reason persisted-unavailable, a held failure and its run stand (the check is for is False so the existing stubs that return None still count as a refresh). Four tests in tests/test_rollup_persisted_failure_hold.py (the dispatcher decline, the negative space True/None still build, the real function does not call connect without the passphrase or backend, the no-connection case); red-without: the passphrase check removed fails 1, the False ignored by the dispatcher fails 1, a truthiness check (not result) fails 2 existing tests. STATED: the persisted store is dormant in shipped code (blank httpfs pins), so this is read from code and exercised through stubs and a patched connect, like #1510; the window it closes (passphrase gone between the verdict and the call) is narrow. NOT fixed, queued: when the encryption gate fails or the persisted open raises, columnar.connect also falls back to an in-memory connection and the function still records it as persisted (it cannot tell the two apart from the connection), and _build_inmemory_and_swap returns None (read as built) when connect gives None.
